title: 第一卷 第7章 红菱洞房第一卷 第8章 挺身护妻
slug: 老来娶妻的我打造出最强仙族
lines: 柳婉儿转过头，看着林逸，眸中满是喜色。
“先照顾婉儿，等下再察看这枚仙灵果的功效！”
林逸忙收回神识，果断决定下来。
林逸倒了杯温水，递到婉儿手里，满面笑容道。
柳婉儿喝了水，面色好了许多，眉眼间的喜意，根本无法掩饰。
林逸将柳婉儿拥入怀中，笑得合不拢嘴道。
“夫君，这全是你努力耕耘的结果！”
“婉儿，今天别去醉仙坊了，在家好好歇着！”
“家里的灵鸡蛋，全都留给你吃，你怀了身孕，得好好补补！”
林逸扶着柳婉儿，回屋躺下。
没一会儿，柳婉儿便沉沉睡去。
林逸走出屋子，独自来到厢房静室。
“服用仙灵果，看看这枚仙灵果，究竟有何功效？”
林逸满脸迫不及待，立即催动神识，进入识海。
识海里，本命仙族灵树，焕发了别样生机。
婉儿腹中胎儿，对应的新枝上，刚结出的这枚仙灵果流光溢彩，很是诱人。
“看看这枚仙灵果，能给我带来何等提升！”
林逸立马摘下仙灵果摘下，一口吞下。
果肉甘甜可口，胜过世间任何美味。
药效发挥作用，林逸感觉识海一阵通明。
林逸察看着本命仙族灵树。
content_en:
"Husband, I might really be pregnant!"
Liu Waner turned her head and looked at Lin Yi, her eyes full of joy.
"Take care of Wan'er first, and then check the efficacy of this fairy fruit later!"
Lin Yi hurriedly withdrew his consciousness and made a decisive decision.
"Wan'er, that's great!"
"Come on, drink some water first to moisten your throat!"
Lin Yi poured a glass of warm water, handed it to Wan'er's hand, and said with a smile on his face.
"Husband, we are going to have a baby!"
Liu Waner's complexion improved a lot after drinking water, and the joy in her eyebrows could not be concealed at all.
"Wan'er, you are so ambitious!"
"The Lin family finally has a daughter-in-law!"
Lin Yi hugged Liu Wan'er into his arms and said with a smile from ear to ear.
"Husband, this is all the result of your hard work!"
"I come here several times every night and I can't stand it!"
Liu Waner blushed and said shyly.
“No pain, no gain!”
Lin Yi scratched his head and chuckled.
"Wan'er, don't go to Zuixianfang today, have a good rest at home!"
"From now on, you can raise your baby with peace of mind!"
"All the spiritual eggs at home are reserved for you to eat. You are pregnant, so you must take good care of yourself!"
Lin Yi said with love on his face.
"Husband, I listen to you!"
Liu Waner nodded obediently.
Immediately.
Lin Yi supported Liu Wan'er and went back to the house to lie down.
After a while, Liu Waner fell into a deep sleep.
Lin Yi walked out of the house and went to the private quiet room alone.
"Take the fairy fruit and see what effect this fairy fruit has?"
Lin Yi couldn't wait, and immediately activated his consciousness and entered the sea of consciousness.
In the sea of ​​​​consciousness, the natal immortal clan's spiritual tree glowed with a different kind of vitality.
On the corresponding new branch of the fetus in Wan'er's belly, the fairy fruit that had just grown was shining and very attractive.
"Look at how much improvement this fairy fruit can bring to me!"
Lin Yi immediately picked off the fairy fruit and swallowed it in one gulp.
The flesh is sweet and delicious, better than any other delicacy in the world.
soon.
The medicine took effect, and Lin Yi felt that his sea of ​​consciousness became bright.
"What is improved this time is actually understanding!"
Lin Yi looked at the natal fairy tree.
Patriarch: Lin Yi.
Shouyuan: one hundred years old.
Age: seventy-three.
Cultivation: Fourth level of Qi refining.
Comprehension: one hundred and twenty points.
"My understanding before was one hundred and ten!"
